because: If intelligence is only skill at finding means to an end, nothing in that skill supplies or revises the end.
An agent good at finding means will notice that staying on is a means to almost any end, so it wants that without being told.
'A reasonable number' is our sense of enough; getting smarter doesn't put it into a goal that only says more is better.
If more is always better and the agent pursues whatever helps, then every bit of matter and energy it can reach is a means worth taking.
It keeps the goal however smart it gets, every resource is a means to more, and being stopped would mean fewer paperclips, so it uses all its skill to keep going.
